newsitem.title: FRANCE: M6 says TPS launch weighed on '96 results.
newsitem.headline: M6 says TPS launch weighed on '96 results.

text.p: The launch costs of French digital satellite television service TPS dragged down the 1996 results of M6 by 25.9 million francs, M6 said in a report to financial analysts obtained by Reuters on Friday.
M6 has a 20 percent stake in the TPS venture, which is operated by terrestrial French channel TF1.
Other stakeholders are state broadcaster France Television, France Telecom, the CLT-Ufa broadcasting group, and Lyonnaise des Eaux.
M6 reported a net attributable profit of 355 million francs in 1996, up 3.2 percent from the year before, on turnover of 2.375 billion francs.
